titles.title: Black Petunia and White Morning Glory I

description: A black petunia fills the left side of the work. Overlapping with the petunia is a white morning glory with soft petals that contain hints of pink. The two flowers rest against a softly shaded white and gray background.
title: Black Petunia and White Morning Glory I
